_doc: Stream V (Expansion 1 §6): THE VOYAGE between the two continents. `harbours` = one per continent: `master` = where the Harbourmaster NPC stands (WORLD metres, like carts.json stops; js/sim/ships.js placeHarbours puts it in the town room it stands in), `dock` = where a voyage TO this harbour puts you ashore, `seaward` = the way to open water from the dock (tools/ship-routes.mjs walks that way to the first water deep enough for a ship: `berth` = where the ship lies, `pier` = the jetty from the shore to it). `sailings` = from -> to with the fare in gold, the time held (`sec`), and `path` = the sea route in world metres from berth to berth (tools/ship-routes.mjs finds it over data/world/horizon.bin, keeping off the coasts). `volcano` = Vharlen's peak for the ash plume (the client takes the highest ground near it). Re-run `node tools/ship-routes.mjs --write` after any re-bake of the coasts. Port Vharl's quay is stream T's `harbour` placement in data/zones/z13_10/placements.json (zone 1505, 914; world 28129, 21394), ~380 m east of the town on the beach; Gullwick stands at the head of Gullwick Bay (play-test 11, Z61: tools/lib/world-core.mjs BAYS): its quay, long pier and two jetties are built by the zone bake (`harbourSite`), its Harbourmaster stands on the quay at the foot of the long pier and the ship lies alongside the pier's end (tools/ship-routes.mjs takes all three from the bake).

service.name: the Narrow Sea Packet
service.line: Three masts, one captain, and no promises about the weather.

says: The Saltwren sails on the tide. Are you coming?
Smoke on the horizon means Vharlen. Fire under the smoke means you have arrived.
